skill.name: csharp-pro
skill.description: Guide modern C# and .NET development with records, pattern matching, async workflows, performance tuning, enterprise patterns, and comprehensive testing.
skill.summary: Build modern C# and .NET applications with practical architecture, testing, and performance guidance.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown backticks around a resource path in SKILL.md. I found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, external network behavior, or executable code in the skill content.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 24 uses Markdown backticks to quote the path `resources/implementation-playbook.md`. It is not Ruby or shell execution and does not instruct command execution.

content.value_statement: Modern .NET projects need clear patterns for maintainable code, async workflows, testing, and performance. This skill guides C# design, implementation, optimization, and validation.
actual_capabilities: Guides use of records, pattern matching, nullable reference types, and other modern C# features.
Recommends ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, Blazor, and .NET ecosystem patterns.
Explains async/await, TPL concurrency, and exception handling for asynchronous code.
Suggests unit testing approaches with xUnit, NUnit, Moq, and FluentAssertions.
Covers performance topics such as Span, Memory, value types, and BenchmarkDotNet.
Helps structure enterprise patterns, microservices, analyzers, EditorConfig, and NuGet configuration.
limitations: It provides guidance but does not run builds, tests, benchmarks, or analyzers by itself.
Detailed examples may be limited because the referenced playbook is not included.
It requires project-specific requirements to choose frameworks, architecture, and dependencies.
It cannot replace security, performance, or compliance review for production systems.

use_cases.title: Implement C# services
use_cases.description: Design ASP.NET Core services with async code, persistence patterns, validation, error handling, and unit tests.

use_cases.title: Standardize team practices
use_cases.description: Create consistent guidance for SOLID design, analyzers, documentation, testing, and dependency management.

use_cases.title: Improve test coverage
use_cases.description: Plan meaningful unit tests with mocks, fluent assertions, and clear verification criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Create a C# component
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design a modern C# component for [feature]. Use nullable reference types, records when useful, and explain validation choices.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor a .NET feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this .NET feature for maintainability. Suggest improvements using SOLID principles, async best practices, and focused unit tests.

prompt_templates.title: Design an enterprise service
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an ASP.NET Core service for [business workflow]. Include architecture boundaries, data access, error handling, testing, and observability.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a hot path
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this performance-sensitive C# workflow. Recommend memory, concurrency, benchmarking, and verification steps before implementation.

output_examples.input: Build a C# API endpoint for creating orders.
output_examples.output: A structured plan covering request models, validation, service boundaries, async persistence, error handling, and unit test coverage.

output_examples.input: Refactor blocking async logic in a service.
output_examples.output: A review summary identifying blocking calls, recommended async patterns, exception handling changes, and verification steps.

output_examples.input: Improve .NET performance in a hot path.
output_examples.output: A practical optimization plan covering allocation reduction, value types, benchmark design, and regression checks.

best_practices: Share framework versions, runtime targets, and existing architecture before asking for implementation guidance.
Ask for tests and verification steps alongside any generated design or implementation plan.
Use the recommendations with local builds, analyzers, benchmarks, and code review.
anti_patterns: Do not request broad rewrites without project constraints, dependencies, or acceptance criteria.
Do not adopt advanced patterns when simple C# constructs meet the requirement.
Do not skip local validation for generated async, performance, or data access changes.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps design, refactor, test, and optimize modern C# and .NET applications.

faq.question: Does it generate production-ready C# code?
faq.answer: It can guide production-oriented code, but teams must validate output with local tests and review.

faq.question: Which frameworks does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, Blazor, testing frameworks, analyzers, and common .NET tooling.

faq.question: Can it improve performance?
faq.answer: It can suggest memory, concurrency, and benchmarking strategies for performance-sensitive C# workflows.

faq.question: Does it execute commands or install packages?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides guidance only. Users must run commands and install packages themselves.

faq.question: Is it useful for legacy .NET projects?
faq.answer: Yes, when the goal is incremental modernization, safer async patterns, better tests, or clearer architecture.
